snippet.title: The First Month of Our Game's Development
snippet.description:
Wishlist here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4522500/Riding_Shotgun/

The first in a short series documenting Riding Shotgun's development up to this point. This episode covers our work from the start of the game's development all the way up until the initial proof of concept.
